name: Benchmark Matrix: Heat Pump Sub-Zero HSPF2 & Ambient COP Degradation
description: # Heat Pump Sub-Zero HSPF2 & Ambient COP Degradation Benchmark Matrix ## 1. Overview & Physical Problem BackgroundAir-source heat pumps (ASHPs) experience non-linear thermal capacity collapse and Coefficient of Performance (COP) degradation as outdoor dry-bulb temperatures drop from nominal rating conditions (+47°F / 8.3°C) into deep sub-zero ambient regimes (-15°F / -26.1°C). Under extreme cold conditions, standard single-stage and dual-stage inverters experience declining suction pressure, elevated compression ratios, and discharge temperature limits, triggering auxiliary electric resistance strip staging (5 kW to 15 kW elements). Conversely, cold-climate air-source heat pumps equipped with Enhanced Vapor Injection (ccASHP with EVI) maintain higher volumetric capacity and superior thermodynamic efficiency down to -15°F. This benchmark dataset provides empirical and deterministic modeling data across 210 sub-freezing ambient temperature, compressor modulation, and system architecture points. --- ## 2.
